hypothesis: kinetic.cursor-glow can be repurposed from a decorative pointer-follow effect into a DISCOVERY MECHANIC: a spotlight that reveals hidden text only where the cursor moves. The glow stops being ornament and starts carrying meaning ('you must move to read').
novelty: cursor-glow has only ever been used decoratively in the studied corpus and in KINETIC's own primitives. This is the first use of it as an information-reveal interaction. No reference site in the corpus uses cursor-position-gated text visibility.
source: Novel composition — not derived from any reference. Combines kinetic.cursor-glow (existing primitive) with a new pointer-proximity text-reveal behavior implemented inline.

implementation.new_behavior: pointermove listener on the field fades hidden-line text to visible when the cursor is within 90px vertical proximity; reverts when the cursor leaves.
implementation.reduced_motion_fallback: hidden-line text is fully visible under prefers-reduced-motion (no gating).

expected_benefit: Adds a 'discovery' interaction class to KINETIC's vocabulary — motion that rewards exploration rather than decorating arrival. If it qualifies, it could seed a new primitive (kinetic.spotlight-reveal) or a recipe role.
risk: Hidden content is invisible until hovered — poor for keyboard/touch users and screen readers if not handled. Mitigated here by reduced-motion fallback, but touch devices get no reveal path (known limitation). Discoverability depends on the on-page hint.

result.note: All deterministic gates pass. Whether the discovery mechanic is delightful or gimmicky is an aesthetic judgment this text-only runtime cannot make.

promotion_note: Per Test-8 rules and Amendment H (AUTO_PROMOTION=OFF), this experiment is NOT promoted. It is recorded for the learning loop. Promotion to a stable primitive/recipe would require human/vision qualification + the promotion gate (Test 10 dry-run path).
known_limitations: Keyboard users cannot trigger the reveal (no focus equivalent wired).
Discoverability relies on the visible hint text.
